title: Pausing mid-step leaves interpolation alpha at -1: paused frame shows entities one step back
detail: doStep calls control.setPaused(true) inside stepper.advance; setPaused->stepper.reset() sets acc=0, then the loop does acc-=STEP_S, so advance returns alpha=-1 (repro: createFixedStepper().advance(0.05,()=>s.reset()) -> -1, acc -0.0167). Every view lerps prev->pos with alpha -1 for the whole pause (hero/golem/minions/shadow hop backwards), and resume loses a step. Fix: in doStep set a pausePending flag and return; apply setPaused after advance() returns (or clamp alpha to [0,1] and have reset() run outside the loop).

title: iOS audio stays silent after an interruption outside the fight
detail: The first-gesture listener is removed once unlocked; afterwards only title Start, the gear and unpause call ac.resume(). iOS Safari moves the AudioContext to 'interrupted'/'suspended' on lock screen, app switch or a call; play() bails when ac.state!=='running' (line ~371), so after an interruption during intro/victory/defeat (no auto-pause there) every SFX and music is lost until the player opens the gear or returns to title. Fix: keep a passive capture pointerdown/keydown listener that calls ac.resume() whenever ac.state!=='running' && !paused, and also resume on visibilitychange->visible.

title: Restart fight unpauses 150 ms before the reset: the fight runs live under the veil
detail: The pause panel's confirmed Restart calls control.setPaused(false) then underVeil(()=>control.retry()) (setTimeout veilInMs). For that window the sim steps with the player's hands off the menu: the golem's queued slam can hit or kill the hero, or a dying golem can award coins, and the retry then runs from a different state than the one the player chose to abandon. Fix: drop the setPaused(false) here; control.retry() already unpauses when it runs.

title: No WebGL context-loss handling or test
detail: No webglcontextlost/webglcontextrestored listeners anywhere in src (grep empty). Three re-initialises GL state on restore, but nothing pauses the fight while the canvas is black, and the path is untested (composer targets, shadow map, CanvasTextures). iOS Safari drops contexts under memory pressure after backgrounding. Fix: on contextlost call control.setPaused(true); on restored force renderer.setQuality(current) to rebuild the composer; add an e2e that uses WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext()/restoreContext() and asserts zero errors plus non-blank pixels.

title: Test hooks with cheat flags ship in the public build
detail: window.__skyrest (setFlags heroInvulnerable/forceDamage, inject, setManual, moment) is installed unconditionally in production. Harmless for a single-player demo, but it is a test surface in play and moment() permanently sets setManual(true) if called from the console. Fix: install only when import.meta.env.DEV, navigator.webdriver, or a ?test query flag is set (and have e2e pass that flag).

title: Per-frame closure and redundant style writes in the HUD loop
detail: updateCoins creates the flyOne closure every frame, and updateHearts writes heartsEl.style.transform='' every frame even when nothing changed. That's small, but it breaks the 'no per-frame allocation' budget rule and adds style invalidation on the phone. Fix: hoist flyOne to module/closure scope (pass n through a counter field), and only write the heart transform while the shake is active or once when it ends.

title: pickAttack fallback can return doubleSlam when it is out of range or before enrage
detail: If float residue leaves r>0 after the weighted loop, the function returns ATTACKS.length-1 (doubleSlam) without checking inRange, so a non-enraged golem could double-slam. Very rare, but a determinism/spec edge. Fix: remember the last in-range index inside the loop and return it.
